components.can: input_slot, named zero-argument slot functions, text_control, prepared_editor local record, fixed heading/paragraph and component editor with inline preparation and form assembly.

Copied publication/control helper semantics are preserved; jobs:: qualifiers removed to bind local helpers. Formatting may reorder boolean match arms, so fixture snippets need not be byte-identical to source.
record-helper-blocked.can and attribute-helper-blocked.can retain rejected assertion proposals; these are negative controls, not executable recommended APIs.
semantics_notes: Original blank publication remains an empty p node; saved publication remains a separate state form.
Blank/hostile editor assertions retained and saved case added. Opaque safe assertions only require successful completion, not rendered content equality.
Component and tree variants share the same inline preparation chain and a local prepared_editor record. Baseline preserves original call order.
input_slot groups label/name/id/max, but its first three members remain str and its constructor stays positional; no refinement or keyword argument system is introduced.
Both layouts consume the exact same prepared method/action attribute tokens. Form assembly is inline in the component version after an opaque-input assertion proposal failed.

Preparation changes constructor failure timing relative to baseline: publication is prepared before edit form assembly. Successful output preservation is established for the four cases, not global failure or occurrence-identity equivalence.
Fixed heading and paragraph helpers do not accept a caller-supplied tag string.

Initial record-helper pilots and corrected local-record pilots are distinct attempts. Root adjusted only inherited form support and an excess inner error arm in the latter; requested grouping/reorder changes were preserved. This is an edit demonstration, not a first-pass reliability benchmark.
